words.example_en: Many Americans regard the jury system as a concrete expression of crucial democratic values, including the principles that all citizens who meet minimal qualifications of age and literacy are equally competent to serve on juries; that jurors should be selected randomly from a representative cross section of the community; that no citizen should be denied the right to serve on a jury on account of race, religion, sex, or national origin; that defendants are entitled to trial by their peers; and that verdicts should represent the conscience of the community and not just the letter of the law.
words.example_cn: 许多美国人把陪审团制度视为重要民主价值观的具体体现，这些原则包括：凡满足年龄和读写能力最低要求的公民都同样有资格担任陪审员；陪审员应从具有代表性的社会各阶层中随机挑选；任何公民都不得因种族、宗教、性别或民族出身而被剥夺担任陪审员的权利；被告有权接受由同侪组成的陪审团的审判；判决应体现社会良知，而不仅仅是法律条文。

words.example_en: Although the Supreme Court of the United States had prohibited intentional racial discrimination in jury selection as early as the 1880 case of Strauder v. West Virginia, the practice of selecting so-called elite or blue-ribbon juries provided a convenient way around this and other antidiscrimination laws.

words.example_en: The man is there to feed the dog, and the dog is there to keep the man away from the machines.
words.example_cn: 人在那里是为了喂狗，而狗在那里是为了不让人靠近机器。

words.example_en: Davidson's article is one of a number of pieces that have recently appeared making the point that the reason we have such stubbornly high unemployment and declining middle-class incomes today is largely because of the big drop in demand because of the Great Recession, but it is also because of the advances in both globalization and the information technology revolution, which are more rapidly than ever replacing labor with machines or foreign workers.
words.example_cn: 戴维森的文章是近来出现的一系列文章之一，它们指出：我们如今之所以有如此顽固的高失业率和不断下降的中产阶级收入，很大程度上是因为大萧条导致的需求骤降，但也因为全球化和信息技术革命的进步——它们正以前所未有的速度用机器或外国工人取代劳动力。

words.example_en: "The future comes at us like empty bottles along an unstoppable and nearly infinite conveyor belt," writes Gary Eberle in his book Sacred Time, and "we feel a pressure to fill these different-sized bottles (days, hours, minutes) as they pass, for if they get by without being filled, we will have wasted them."
words.example_cn: “未来就像永不停歇、永无止境传送带上的空瓶子一样向我们走来”，盖里·埃伯利在他《神圣的时间》一书中写道：“随着时间的流逝，我们要把这些不同大小的瓶子（天，小时，分钟）装满，对此我们倍感压力，因为如果它们没有被装满就过去了，我们就是浪费了它们。”
